s1.title: Welcome to Fredheim Meal Planner
s1.body: Plan healthy weekly menus, generate shopping lists in seconds, and discover recipes designed to help you feel your best — all in one place.

s2.title: Browse hundreds of recipes
s2.body: Start with our built-in Fredheim collection or install specialty packs like the Reversal Protocol — plant-based, heart-disease-reversing recipes.
s2.tip: Find packs under Packs in the menu and tap Install.

s3.title: Build your week in minutes
s3.body: Open the Planner, tap any meal slot, and pick a recipe. Drag to rearrange, copy across days, or save the whole week as a template for later.
s3.tip: Filter recipes by pack when picking — perfect for sticking to one diet.

s4.title: Automatic shopping list
s4.body: Once your week is planned, the Shopping tab assembles every ingredient, grouped by store aisle, scaled to your family size.
s4.tip: Print it for the store or save it to revisit later.

s5.title: Tailor it to your family
s5.body: Under Settings, set your family size, switch between metric and US units, and choose your language. Every recipe scales automatically.

s6.title: See the full nutrition
s6.body: Recipes in nutrition-rich packs show macros, vitamins, and minerals — switch between Per Serving, Per 100 g, or the full recipe at any time.
s6.tip: Great for tracking heart health, diabetes, or daily nutrient targets.

s7.title: You're ready!
s7.body: Tap Let's go to start exploring. You can replay this tour any time from Settings → App tutorial.

welcome.title: Welcome to Fredheim
welcome.body: Plant-based, whole-food recipes from Fredheim Livsstilssenter, a doctor-led lifestyle centre, and a planner that turns them into your week, your shopping list and your nutrition overview. Less time deciding, more time eating well.

recipes.title: Recipes you’ll want to cook
recipes.body: Every recipe has a photo, clear steps and nutrition for each serving. Change the number of servings and every amount follows.

labels.title: Find food that suits you
labels.body: Labels show which recipes are designed with blood pressure, diabetes, heart health or weight loss in mind, and which are gluten-free, nut-free or quick. Tap one or more to filter.

salt.title: Salt the way you need it
salt.body: Recipes are written low in salt. Healthy adults can switch to Standard, a normal amount within WHO advice. Choose per recipe, or once for everything in Settings.

makeWeek.title: A whole week planned in a minute
makeWeek.body: Open the Planner and tap Make my week. Answer a few short questions and you get meals for the whole week, ready to use.

goals.title: Tell it what you’re aiming for
goals.body: Healthy everyday food, weight loss, blood pressure, type 2 diabetes or heart health: the week is built from recipes designed for that goal. Pick heart health for Ornish-style Reversal recipes, or load the ready-made 5-day fasting-mimicking plan.

calories.title: Portions that fit your day
calories.body: Set a daily calorie target, or none, and choose how many meals you eat. Portions are sized so each day lands near your target, and the shopping list buys exactly that.

prefs.title: Your taste, your rules
prefs.body: Savoury or sweet breakfasts, your favourites first, and anything you’ve marked “not for me” left out. Want fewer ingredients? Ask for a shorter shopping list and dishes that share them.

preview.title: See the week before you use it
preview.body: Check kcal and fibre for each day and what to cook on Sunday: one big soup, a bread and a spread that cover several days. Not quite right? Shuffle.

planner.title: Your week at a glance
planner.body: Everything lands in the Planner, where you can add, swap or remove any meal. Batch-cooked dishes have their own column, so you can see what’s already made.

shopping.title: The shopping list writes itself
shopping.body: Every ingredient for the week, added up and scaled to the number of people. Tick things off in the shop, print the list or share it.
shopping.callout: Added up for the whole week

nutrition.title: Keep an eye on nutrition
nutrition.body: Log what you ate straight from your plan and see calories, protein, fibre, minerals and more for the day or the week.
nutrition.callout: Add today’s meals from the plan

settings.title: Make it yours
settings.body: Choose your language (English, Norwegian or Swedish), household size, units, allergens to avoid and your usual salt level. You can take this tour again from Settings at any time.

done.title: Ready when you are
done.body_makeWeek: Let Make my week plan your first week now. You can change everything afterwards.
done.body_trial: Start your 14-day free trial to unlock the planner, the shopping list and every recipe. No card needed.
done.body_explore: Have a look around. You can take this tour again from Settings at any time.
